ui.network_note: Address browsers use to reach the PACS, port included. It drives redirects, session cookies and the certificate.

ui.network_readonly: The .env file is not reachable: the address cannot be changed from the panel.
ui.backups_note: Created automatically before every write to the Orthanc configuration or the user list. The last ten are kept.
